results.answer:
type Timesheet = record(name: str, hours: list<dec>)

fun total(t: Timesheet) -> dec = t.hours.sum()

fun overtime(t: Timesheet) -> dec = t.hours.filter { it > 40.0 }.sum()

fun pay(t: Timesheet, rate: dec) -> dec = total(t) + overtime(t) * 1.5 * rate
